sentences.zh: 但我正在往里面加东西。

sentences.en: And when you add whatever I have to add, it's all going to happen where we're going to build a beautiful, big,
sentences.zh: 而当你加上我必须添加的任何内容时，这一切都会发生，我们将建造一座美丽、宏大、

sentences.en: strong wall that's not going to let criminals and traffickers and drug dealers and drugs into our country.
sentences.zh: 坚固的墙，它不会让罪犯、人口贩子、毒贩和毒品进入我们的国家。

sentences.en: It's very simple.
sentences.zh: 这非常简单。

sentences.en: It's very simple.
sentences.zh: 这非常简单。

sentences.en: We're building a wall.
sentences.zh: 我们在建一堵墙。

sentences.en: Sir, do you want to go through another shutdown?
sentences.zh: 先生，您想经历另一次政府关门吗？

sentences.en: I don't think you're going to see a shutdown.
sentences.zh: 我认为你们不会看到政府关门。

sentences.en: I wouldn't want to go through, no.
sentences.zh: 我不想经历，不。

sentences.en: If you did have it, it's the Democrats' fault.
sentences.zh: 如果真的发生了，那是民主党人的错。

sentences.en: There won't be a shutdown, which implies I'll sign the deal.
sentences.zh: 不会有关门，这意味着我会签署这项协议。

sentences.en: But then he goes on to say, look, this will be, quote, hooked up with lots of money from other sources.
sentences.zh: 但接着他继续说道，听着，这将与，引述一下，来自其他来源的大量资金挂钩。

sentences.en: In other words, he's suggesting I'm going to find other pots of money to build this wall.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他是在暗示我要寻找其他资金来源来建这堵墙。

sentences.en: And the next day, the president left open the option of declaring a national emergency.
sentences.zh: 而在第二天，总统为宣布国家紧急状态留出了可能性。

sentences.en: This is an executive action, constitutionally authorized, that allows the president to, in essence,
sentences.zh: 这是一项行政行动，受宪法授权，本质上允许总统

sentences.en: spend money that was not appropriated by Congress if he can show the evidence of a genuine national security emergency.
sentences.zh: 花费未获国会拨款的资金，前提是他能提供真正国家安全紧急情况的证据。

sentences.en: And that's always been, to some extent, the nuclear option that the president has reserved in the event that he can't get the money any other way.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这一直是总统保留的终极手段，以防他无法通过其他途径获得资金。

sentences.en: And does that nuclear option of declaring a national emergency, does it feel in this moment like a real possibility?
sentences.zh: 那么，宣布国家紧急状态这种终极手段，在此刻感觉像是一个真正的可能性吗？

sentences.en: Well, the president has kept it open as a possibility throughout this entire dispute, but it's kind of waxed and waned over the period of time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在整场争端中，总统一直将其作为一种可能性保留着，但它在这段期间时起时伏。

sentences.en: The complicating factor for the president is that Republican lawmakers, notably Mitch McConnell, really opposed the idea of the president going this route.
sentences.zh: 对总统来说复杂的因素是，共和党议员，尤其是米奇·麦康奈尔，非常反对总统走这条路。

sentences.en: McConnell cautioned President Trump privately about the consequences of declaring a national emergency, telling him the move could trigger political blowback and divide the GOP.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔私下里警告过特朗普总统宣布国家紧急状态的后果，告诉他此举可能会引发政治反弹并分裂共和党。

sentences.en: We've not had the procedure before because the national emergencies that have been issued in the past have not been contentious.
sentences.zh: 我们以前没有过这种程序，因为过去发布过的国家紧急状态并不具有争议性。

sentences.en: I'm pretty sure that this one would be.
sentences.zh: 我很确定这次会有。

sentences.en: And their reasoning is very simple.
sentences.zh: 他们的理由非常简单。

sentences.en: If a Republican president can invoke a national emergency to spend money around Congress,
sentences.zh: 如果一名共和党总统可以援引国家紧急状态来绕过国会花钱，

sentences.en: what's going to stop a future Democratic president from evoking a different national emergency and spending money and making an end run around Congress?
sentences.zh: 有什么能阻止未来的民主党总统援引不同的国家紧急状态来花钱并绕过国会呢？

sentences.en: That's what Republicans are really worried about.
sentences.zh: 这正是共和党人真正担心的事情。

sentences.en: And that's the principal reason that they've been pushing back on this declaration of an emergency.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们一直抵制这项紧急状态宣言的主要原因。

sentences.en: So it seemed like a real long shot.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来希望十分渺茫。

sentences.en: Now to the effort to prevent another government shutdown when federal funding runs out Friday night.
sentences.zh: 现在谈谈为防止联邦经费在周五晚耗尽而再次导致政府关门所做出的努力。

sentences.en: All sides are sounding optimistic that President Trump will sign the deal.
sentences.zh: 各方都对特朗普总统会签署该协议表达了乐观的态度。

sentences.en: If there are no major surprises, lawmakers believe it will pass with significant support and is likely to be signed by the president.
sentences.zh: 如果没有重大意外，议员们相信它将以压倒性支持获得通过，并很可能由总统签署。

sentences.en: Then we wake up on Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在周四早晨醒来。

sentences.en: The Senate will come to order.
sentences.zh: 参议院即将开会。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Let us pray.
sentences.zh: 让我们祈祷。

sentences.en: The Senate and the House have both scheduled votes.
sentences.zh: 参议院和众议院都已安排了投票表决。

sentences.en: On this compromise spending bill.
sentences.zh: 为了这项妥协的开支法案。

sentences.en: And it really looks like the president has finally backed himself into a corner.
sentences.zh: 而这看起来确实像总统终于把自己逼入了绝境。

sentences.en: Like he really will have little choice but to sign the bill when it reaches his desk.
sentences.zh: 就像当法案摆在桌上时，他真的别无选择，只能将其签署。

sentences.en: We pray in the most holy name of Christ Jesus, our Lord.
sentences.zh: 我们以我们的主基督耶稣最圣洁的名义祈祷。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: Among other things, you have one of his staunchest Republican supporters in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，参议院里还有他最坚定的共和党支持者之一。

sentences.en: So I'll pray that the president will have wisdom to sign the bill so government doesn't shut down.
sentences.zh: 所以我祈祷总统有智慧签署该法案，这样政府就不会关门。

sentences.en: Senator Chuck Grassley.
sentences.zh: 参议员查克·格拉斯利。

sentences.en: Join me and pledge.
sentences.zh: 请和我一起宣誓。

sentences.en: I pledge allegiance to the flag of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我效忠美利坚合众国国旗。

sentences.en: Actually praying with his colleagues that President Trump will sign this spending bill.
sentences.zh: 实际上是在和同僚一起祈祷特朗普总统会签署这项开支法案。

sentences.en: So it's clear that even among his own party, the heavy presumption is that the president has no choice.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，即使在他的党内，人们普遍认为总统别无选择。

sentences.en: He really has to capitulate.
sentences.zh: 他真的必须妥协。

sentences.en: He really has to sign the bill.
sentences.zh: 他真的必须签署法案。

sentences.en: So then what happens?
sentences.zh: 那接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, then, interestingly, Chuck Grassley is on the floor of the Senate speaking about an unrelated topic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，随后有趣的是，查克·格拉斯利在参议院发言，谈论一个不相关的话题。

sentences.en: The letter reads in part, allowing these tax credits.
sentences.zh: 信中部分内容写道，允许这些税收抵免。

sentences.en: And Mitch McConnell, the Senate majority leader, interrupts him.
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔打断了他。

sentences.en: About the availability of these.
sentences.zh: 关于这些的可获得性。

sentences.en: Where'd the senator yield?
sentences.zh: 参议员是否让步？

sentences.en: Jeopardizing the long-term investments.
sentences.zh: 危及长期投资。

sentences.en: In fact, it makes Chuck Grassley kind of angry.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这让查克·格拉斯利有点生气。

sentences.en: He says to him, you're being rude by interrupting me.
sentences.zh: 他对他说，你打断我的发言是很粗鲁的。

sentences.en: I hope the next time I get a chance to have the floor, I won't be interrupted.
sentences.zh: 我希望下次我有机会发言时，不会被人打断。

sentences.en: I yield the floor and put the rest of my statement in the record.
sentences.zh: 我让出发言权，并将我其余的陈述记入记录。

sentences.en: But Mitch McConnell has something very important to say.
sentences.zh: 但米奇·麦康奈尔有非常重要的事情要说。

sentences.en: Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 总统先生。

sentences.en: Leader McConnell.
sentences.zh: 领袖麦康奈尔。

sentences.en: I've just had an opportunity to speak with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚有机会与特朗普总统交谈过。

sentences.en: And he, I would say to all my colleagues, has indicated he's prepared to sign the bill.
sentences.zh: 我想对所有的同僚说，他已经表示他准备签署这项法案。

sentences.en: He will also be issuing a national emergency declaration at the same time.
sentences.zh: 他同时也将在同一时间发布国家紧急状态宣言。

sentences.en: He basically says, we're going to call this vote, the president is going to sign this measure, and oh, by the way, he's also going to declare a national emergency.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是说，我们要进行这次投票，总统将签署这项法案，哦，顺便说一句，他还要宣布进入国家紧急状态。

sentences.en: So he delivers the news of the day.
sentences.zh: 于是他传达了当天的重大新闻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's when our friend Peter Baker runs out of his studio.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我们的朋友彼得·贝克冲出了他的演播室。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what exactly is McConnell communicating here?
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔在这里到底传达了什么？

sentences.en: What is suddenly now the plan versus what we had thought would be happening on Thursday?
sentences.zh: 与我们原以为周四会发生的事情相比，现在的计划突然变成了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he's in essence laying out a kind of a two-track strategy on the part of the White House.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他本质上是在阐述白宫方面的一种双轨战略。

sentences.en: On the one hand, the president's going to sign the spending bill.
sentences.zh: 一方面，总统将签署开支法案。

sentences.en: He's going to avert a second shutdown.
sentences.zh: 他将避免第二次政府关门。

sentences.en: He's going to finally put this very vexing issue to rest, which is a huge source of relief for Democrats and Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他将最终平息这个极其棘手的问题，这对于民主党人和共和党人来说都是巨大的解脱。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, he's going to plunge into this highly uncertain, very fraught issue of declaring a national emergency.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，他将陷入宣布国家紧急状态这一高度不确定且充满争议的问题中。

sentences.en: This is something that will almost certainly be challenged legally.
sentences.zh: 这几乎肯定会在法律上受到挑战。

sentences.en: It could go up to the Supreme Court fairly rapidly as a test of the president's authority and prerogative.
sentences.zh: 它可能会相当迅速地提交到最高法院，以检验总统的权力和特权。

sentences.en: So he's kind of on the one hand settling a housekeeping issue that was very problematic for Congress and the White House and embarking on this very uncertain course with his declaration of a national emergency.
sentences.zh: 所以他一方面解决了对国会和白宫来说非常麻烦的例行事务，另一方面又通过宣布国家紧急状态踏上了一条充满不确定性的道路。

sentences.en: And what does McConnell say about how he and his fellow Republicans in Congress will respond to this controversial idea of an emergency declaration?
sentences.zh: 那么，关于他和国会中的共和党同僚将如何应对紧急状态宣言这一具争议的想法，麦康奈尔说了什么？

sentences.en: And I've indicated to him that I'm going to prepare, I'm going to support the national emergency declaration.
sentences.zh: 而且我已经向他表明，我将准备，我将支持国家紧急状态宣言。

sentences.en: Well, what he says is, I'm going to support the president in his declaration.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他说的是，我将支持总统的宣言。

sentences.en: And that's a remarkable statement coming from Mitch McConnell.
sentences.zh: 对于米奇·麦康奈尔来说，这是一个非同寻常的表态。

sentences.en: Remember, this is the senator who, during the Obama administration,
sentences.zh: 记住，这就是那位在奥巴马政府期间的参议员，

sentences.en: fought so fiercely against Barack Obama when he tried to use executive authority to spend money that had not been appropriated by Congress.
sentences.zh: 当奥巴马试图利用行政权力花费未经国会拨款的资金时，他进行了极其激烈的抗争。

sentences.en: This is the senator who has stood up for the prerogatives of Congress, the appropriators of money in the government.
sentences.zh: 这位参议员曾坚定捍卫国会的特权，捍卫政府资金的拨付权力。

sentences.en: And yet here he is saying, I'm going to support the president as he heads down this legally dubious,
sentences.zh: 然而此时此刻，他说，我将支持总统走这条在法律上存疑、

sentences.en: politically difficult course and potentially sets a very bad precedent for the relations between Congress and the executive branch in the future.
sentences.zh: 在政治上困难重重的道路，这可能会为未来国会与行政分支的关系开创一个非常坏的先例。

sentences.en: So what explains that sudden change in approach to executive authority?
sentences.zh: 那么，是什么解释了这种对待行政权力的突然转变？

sentences.en: I'm not sure Mitch McConnell has changed his view on executive authority.
sentences.zh: 我不确定米奇·麦康奈尔改变了对行政权力的看法。

sentences.en: I think Mitch McConnell recognized that the president was in such a political box.
sentences.zh: 我认为米奇·麦康奈尔认识到总统陷入了如此艰难的政治困境。

sentences.en: He didn't want the president to shut down the government again.
sentences.zh: 他不想让总统再次关闭政府。

sentences.en: But I think he recognized that the president needed to do something to show his political supporters he wasn't capitulating entirely.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他认识到总统需要做点什么来向他的政治支持者证明他并非完全妥协。

sentences.en: And with that, I asked the chair to lay before the Senate the conference report to accompany House Joint Resolution 31.
sentences.zh: 有鉴于此，我请求主席将众议院第31号联合决议的会议报告提交参议院审议。

sentences.en: The clerk will report.
sentences.zh: 书记官将宣读法案。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能查阅所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载纽约时报应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，请立即下载《时报》应用，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So how exactly, Mark, would this work?
sentences.zh: 那么马克，这到底该如何运作呢？

sentences.en: What does this declaration of a national emergency actually mean?
sentences.zh: 宣布国家紧急状态到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: And how precisely does it get the president the money for his wall?
sentences.zh: 它又是如何精确地为总统的墙筹集资金的呢？

sentences.en: Well, we're in kind of uncharted waters here, and the White House has not detailed how it would seek funding under a declaration.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们这里正处于未知的领域，白宫尚未详细说明它将如何在宣言下寻求资金。

sentences.en: But in effect, the president would transmit to Congress a statement saying, I declare there to be a national emergency on our southern border.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，总统将向国会提交一份声明，称我宣布我们的南部边境进入国家紧急状态。

sentences.en: And in order to address that emergency, I need X amount of funding, and I propose to get it from one of two or three different places.
sentences.zh: 为了应对这一紧急情况，我需要X数量的资金，我提议从两三个不同地方中的某一个地方筹集。

sentences.en: The places that people have focused on are pools of money that's available under the authority of the Secretary of Defense and the Secretary of the Army to spend money to,
sentences.zh: 人们关注的地方是国防部长和陆军部长权力范围内可用的资金池，用于花费资金来，

sentences.en: in effect, strengthen the defenses of the homeland.
sentences.zh: 实际上加强本土防御。

sentences.en: This is money that, for example, if there was an invasion of the country or something like that, it would allow the military to spend large amounts of money.
sentences.zh: 这笔资金例如在国家遭受入侵之类的情况下，将允许军方支出了大量的资金。

sentences.en: The president presumably would argue that this situation is analogous to that, and I therefore should be allowed to draw from these pools of funds.
sentences.zh: 总统大概会辩称这种情况与此类似，因此我应该被允许从这些资金池中提取资金。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the emergency declaration is a way of completing a math problem for the president,
sentences.zh: 所以紧急状态宣言是为总统完成一道数学题的一种方式，

sentences.en: getting the money in this compromised border security deal and whatever he can cobble together from inside the government to suddenly get to the number of $5.7 billion.
sentences.zh: 将这笔妥协的边境安全交易中的资金以及他能从政府内部拼凑出的任何资金结合起来，最终凑够57亿美元的数字。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: A math problem is a very good way of thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 用数学题来形容它是一个非常好的视角。

sentences.en: And there's an ancillary benefit to a declaration of the national emergency.
sentences.zh: 宣布国家紧急状态还有一个附带好处。

sentences.en: It really changes the subject.
sentences.zh: 它确实转移了话题。

sentences.en: Rather than headlines that will simply say, Trump buckles, Trump yields, Trump gives up, Trump signs a deal he hates, you have very dramatic headlines that say,
sentences.zh: 与其看到那些只会说“特朗普屈服了”、“特朗普让步了”、“特朗普放弃了”、“特朗普签署了一份他讨厌的协议”的头条新闻，你现在可以看到非常戏剧化的头条新闻，写着

sentences.en: Trump declares a national emergency.
sentences.zh: 特朗普宣布国家紧急状态。

sentences.en: His political supporters will eat that up.
sentences.zh: 他的政治支持者会非常受用。

sentences.en: It will make him look like, once again, he's the disruptor.
sentences.zh: 这会让他看起来再一次像个颠覆者。

sentences.en: He's breaking all the rules.
sentences.zh: 他在打破所有规则。

sentences.en: He's willing to try something totally unorthodox to get what he has promised during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 他愿意尝试完全非传统的手段来兑现他在竞选期间的承诺。

sentences.en: And, Mark, how are members of Congress beyond Senator Mitch McConnell, particularly the ones who are negotiating this border security compromise,
sentences.zh: 马克，国会议员们——除了参议员米奇·麦康奈尔之外，尤其是那些正在谈判这项边境安全妥协方案的议员们，

sentences.en: how are they reacting to what seems like a very explicit effort to circumvent them?
sentences.zh: 他们对这种看起来非常明确旨在绕过他们的努力作何反应？

sentences.en: Well, among Republicans, there are very mixed feelings.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在共和党人当中，有着非常复杂的感受。

sentences.en: While Mitch McConnell has kind of laid down a supportive line from the leadership level, Rand Paul has come out against this.
sentences.zh: 虽然米奇·麦康奈尔在领导层面上奠定了支持的基调，但兰德·保罗已经公开反对这一点。

sentences.en: The more moderate Republican senators have said it's a bad idea.
sentences.zh: 较温和的共和党参议员表示，这是个糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: As you might expect, the Democrats are rising up uniformly to say the president has no authority to do this.
sentences.zh: 正如你所料，民主党人纷纷站出来，称总统无权这样做。

sentences.en: Declares this emergency.
sentences.zh: 宣布进入这一紧急状态。

sentences.en: First of all, it's not an emergency.
sentences.zh: 首先，这根本不是什么紧急状态。

sentences.en: What's happening at the border?
sentences.zh: 边境那边发生了什么？

sentences.en: Speaker Nancy Pelosi came out and said, quote, the president is doing an end run around Congress.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长南希·佩洛西站出来说，引述她的原话，总统这是在绕过国会。

sentences.en: She promised to bring a legal challenge against the White House almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 她承诺几乎会立即对白宫提起法律诉讼。

sentences.en: So that set the tone on the House side.
sentences.zh: 这就为众议院的基调定下了基调。

sentences.en: And, Mark, what would be the basis for suing to stop the president from declaring what he thinks is an emergency?
sentences.zh: 那么，马克，起诉阻止总统宣布他认为的紧急状态，依据会是什么？

sentences.en: It's basically the whole notion of separation of powers.
sentences.zh: 这基本上涉及到三权分立的整个概念。

sentences.en: The power to appropriate, the power to spend money is vested in the legislative branch, in Congress.
sentences.zh: 拨款的权力、花钱的权力归属于立法机构，也就是国会。

sentences.en: That is the heart of what Congress does.
sentences.zh: 这正是国会职责的核心。

sentences.en: The president does not have constitutional authority to do that, except under very extraordinary circumstances.
sentences.zh: 总统没有宪法权力这样做，除非在非常特殊的情况下。

sentences.en: And that's the principle that's going to be tested when this goes to the courts, as it inevitably will.
sentences.zh: 这就是当这件事闹上法庭时将要接受检验的原则，而这必然会发生。

sentences.en: So there's a very real possibility that the president will declare a national emergency, and it will be gummed up in legal system,
sentences.zh: 因此，存在一种非常现实的可能性，即总统将宣布国家紧急状态，然后它将在法律系统中陷入瘫痪，

sentences.en: and he will not be able to find that money through that tactic.
sentences.zh: 并且他将无法通过这种策略找到资金。

sentences.en: In fact, that's the most likely scenario, that this gets tied up in the courts, goes as high as the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 事实上，最有可能的情况是，这件事被缠在法院里，一直闹到最高法院。

sentences.en: Of course, he has a majority of conservative justices on the court, but many of those justices are deeply suspicious about a president exceeding his constitutional authority.
sentences.zh: 当然，最高法院里有多数保守派大法官，但其中许多大法官对总统超越其宪法权力深表怀疑。

sentences.en: I think he needs to show his base he's willing to do whatever it takes to keep building the wall.
sentences.zh: 我认为他需要向他的基本盘展示，他愿意不惜一切代价继续修建隔离墙。

sentences.en: So how has the base reacted to this decision he's made in the past few hours to make the declaration of national emergency?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于他在过去几个小时内作出宣布国家紧急状态的决定，基本盘作何反应？

sentences.en: Well, the initial reaction is not good.
sentences.zh: 嗯，最初的反应并不好。

sentences.en: Ann Coulter, the conservative columnist who has been at the vanguard of pressuring the president on this issue, I'll read you a couple of her tweets.
sentences.zh: 安·库尔特，这位一直带头就此问题向总统施压的保守派专栏作家——我读一下她的几条推文。

sentences.en: The first one says about the national emergency,
sentences.zh: 第一条关于国家紧急状态写道：

sentences.en: I have to imagine that's not the response President Trump was expecting, and I guess I'm not quite certain why that is the response, if he's getting the job done in his mind.
sentences.zh: 我不得不猜想，这并非特朗普总统所期待的反应，而且我猜我不太明白为什么会是这种反应，如果在他看来事情已经办妥了的话。

sentences.en: First of all, I agree with you.
sentences.zh: 首先，我同意你的看法。

sentences.en: I think that is not the response he expected.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实不是他所预料的反应。

sentences.en: I think he will be really rather brutally disappointed by it.
sentences.zh: 我想他对此会感到相当残酷的失望。

sentences.en: And I think the reason he's getting that response is, the assumption is, that it will get gummed up in the courts, that it will be challenged, that he will never get the money,
sentences.zh: 我认为他得到这种反应的原因是，人们推测这会在法庭上陷入僵局，会遭到质疑，他永远也拿不到资金，

sentences.en: and that hence he will never build the wall.
sentences.zh: 因此他永远也建不成这堵墙。

sentences.en: So where does this leave the president's standing, this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么，此时此刻这让总统处于什么地位？

sentences.en: He can't get the wall funded through Congress.
sentences.zh: 他无法通过国会为隔离墙获得资金。

sentences.en: He's trying to do it through an emergency declaration, but not even his biggest supporters in the conservative world think that's going to work.
sentences.zh: 他正试图通过紧急状态令来做到这一点，但连保守派阵营里他最坚定的支持者都不认为这会行得通。

sentences.en: So where is he?
sentences.zh: 那他现在在哪儿呢？

sentences.en: Well, President Trump will keep talking about the border wall.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普总统会继续谈论边境墙。

sentences.en: He'll keep going to Make America Great Again rallies, at which he will say, we're building the wall, we're finishing the wall.
sentences.zh: 他会继续参加“让美国再次伟大”的集会，并在会上说，我们在建墙，我们在完成建墙。

sentences.en: He'll talk about new miles of wall being built, or fencing, or barriers, or whatever word he chooses to use.
sentences.zh: 他会谈到正在修建的数英里新墙、围栏、屏障，或者他选择使用的任何词汇。

sentences.en: But as time goes on, I think it will become clearer and clearer that this wall is not being built, certainly not on the scale he promised during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间推移，我认为会越来越清楚，这堵墙并没有在建，当然绝对没有达到他在竞选期间承诺的规模。

sentences.en: And that will expose the weakness of his skills as a dealmaker.
sentences.zh: 这将暴露出他作为一个交易制造者的能力之弱。

sentences.en: And frankly, even as a rhetorical device, the wall will become less and less effective for him over time.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，甚至作为一个修辞工具，隔离墙对他而言随着时间推移也会越来越无效。

sentences.en: And he will look weak.
sentences.zh: 而且他看起来会很软弱。

sentences.en: Finally, Mark, how is Peter?
sentences.zh: 最后，马克，彼得最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I assume he's hunched over a computer pounding away, which is, after all, what they pay us to do most of the time.
sentences.zh: 我猜他正驼着背对着电脑疯狂敲键盘呢，毕竟，这就是他们付钱让我们大部分时间在做的事情。

sentences.en: I thought they paid you to be on the daily.
sentences.zh: 我还以为他们付钱让你上《每日秀》呢。

sentences.en: Grudgingly.
sentences.zh: 勉勉强强吧。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mark.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，马克。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Thursday night, both the Senate and House passed the Compromise Border Security Bill that would give the president $1.3 billion for his border wall.
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，参议院和众议院均通过了折中的《边境安全法案》，该法案将向总统提供13亿美元用于修建边境墙。

sentences.en: That bill now heads to Trump's desk, where he is expected to sign it, along with the emergency declaration.
sentences.zh: 该法案现在将呈交特朗普办公桌，预计他会连同紧急状态令一起签署。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Are there any senators in the chamber wishing to vote or change their vote?
sentences.zh: 议会厅里有没有参议员希望投票或更改投票？

sentences.en: If not, the yeas are 54, the nays are 45.
sentences.zh: 如果没有，赞成票54票，反对票45票。

sentences.en: Nomination is confirmed.
sentences.zh: 提名获得确认。

sentences.en: On Thursday,
sentences.zh: 在周四，

sentences.en: the Senate confirmed President Trump's choice for Attorney General William Barr in a highly partisan vote over who should lead the department overseeing the special counsel's Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 参议院以党派色彩浓厚的投票结果，确认了特朗普总统对司法部长人选威廉·巴尔的提名，双方在谁来领导监督特别检察官俄罗斯调查的部门上存在分歧。

sentences.en: Just three Democrats voted for Barr, who has embraced a sweeping view of presidential power that many of them fear could influence the course of the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 只有三名民主党人投赞成票支持巴尔，他此前曾对总统权力抱有广阔的看法，许多民主党人担心这可能会影响俄罗斯调查的进程。

sentences.en: Republicans, all but one of whom, Rand Paul, voted for Barr, said he would bring stability to the Department of Justice after the rocky tenure of Attorney General Jeff Sessions,
sentences.zh: 共和党人——除了兰德·保罗一人外全部投票支持巴尔——表示，在杰夫·塞申斯这位因回避特别检察官小组而被特朗普解职的司法部长经历动荡任期后，巴尔将为司法部带来稳定。

sentences.en: who was fired by Trump for recusing himself from the special counsel group.
sentences.zh: 这位司法部长此前因主动回避特别检察官调查而被特朗普解职。

sentences.en: In an abrupt move, Amazon has canceled its plan to build a headquarters in New York City after Democratic lawmakers opposed a nearly $3 billion package of government subsidies.
sentences.zh: 在一次突然的举动中，亚马逊取消了在纽约市建设总部的计划，此前民主党议员反对了一项价值近30亿美元的政府补贴方案。

sentences.en: Supporters of the headquarters said it would provide well-paying jobs to about 25,000 people in Queens.
sentences.zh: 总部支持者表示，它将为皇后区大约25,000人提供薪酬优厚的工作岗位。

sentences.en: But opponents, including liberal leaders like Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, who represents Queens,
sentences.zh: 但反对者，包括代表皇后区的国会议员亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯等自由派领袖，

sentences.en: questioned why taxpayers should subsidize a company that earns $10 billion a year.
sentences.zh: 质疑为什么纳税人要去补贴一家年赚100亿美元的公司。

sentences.en: In a tweet after Amazon's announcement, Ocasio-Cortez said, quote,
sentences.zh: 在亚马逊宣布消息后的一条推文中，奥卡西奥-科尔特斯表示：

sentences.en: Today was the day a group of dedicated everyday New Yorkers and their neighbors defeated Amazon's corporate greed.
sentences.zh: 今天是充满奉献精神的日常纽约人及其邻居们击败亚马逊企业贪婪的日子。

sentences.en: The Daily is produced by Theo Balcom, Lindsay Garrison, Rachel Quester, Annie Brown, Andy Mills, Ike Sris-Khanaraja, Claire Tennesketter, Michael Simon-Johnson, Jessica Chung,
sentences.zh: 《每日秀》由西奥·巴尔科姆、林赛·加里森、蕾切尔·克斯特、安妮·布朗、安迪·米尔斯、艾克·斯里-克纳拉加、克莱尔·特内斯凯特、迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊、杰西卡·钟、

sentences.en: Alexandra Lee Young, and Jonathan Wolfe, and edited by Paige Cowan, Larissa Anderson, and Wendy Doerr.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉·李·杨和乔纳森·沃尔夫制作，由佩吉·考恩、拉里萨·安德森和温迪·多尔编辑。

sentences.en: Lisa Tobin is our executive producer.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·托宾是我们的执行制片人。

sentences.en: Samantha Hennig is our editorial director.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎·亨尼格是我们的主编。

sentences.en: Our technical manager is Brad Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我们的技术经理是布拉德·费舍尔。

sentences.en: Our engineer is Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 我们的工程师是克里斯·伍德。

sentences.en: And our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由仙境乐队的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Sam Dolnick, Michaela Bouchard, and Stella Tan.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢萨姆·多尔尼克、米凯拉·布夏尔和斯特拉·陈。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日秀》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Tuesday after the holiday.
sentences.zh: 假期后周二见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《割草机秀》中，我们正在为主办节日聚会做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是晕厥过去才能睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在纽约时报应用程序或您喜欢收听的任何地方查找《割草机秀》。

sentences.en: What time do they like to listen?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点收听？
